headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: (STL) Result Update| Sector: Auto Ancillary SBICAP Securities Limited | 2 Key Highlights of the 2QFY27 Result Sandhar Technologies Ltd (STL) reported record 2Q/1HFY27 revenues of Rs 1,618 cr/Rs 3,000 cr, driven by strong market share gains and industry outperformance.
The core business (excluding new facilities) remained healthy, delivering Rs 1,454 cr revenue (+27% YoY) and Rs 149 cr EBITDA (+24% YoY) with EBITDA margins of 10.2%.

Consolidated EBITDA margins moderated to 8.5% due to wage inflation (Rs 13 cr in 1H), commodity cost pressures, and start-up losses from new facilities, which generated Rs 164 cr revenue but reported Rs 17 cr PBT loss.
Management expects 30-40 bps margin improvement in 2H, aided by commodity cost pass-through and operating leverage.
valuation: Separately, the Sanaswadi (Pune) Cabin Fabrication facility is targeted to turn around in 3QFY27, while the Oragadam Sheet Metal and Romania Die- casting operations are expected to achieve meaningful profitability from FY28.
Maintain BUY – Target Price unchanged at Rs 876 Our thesis remains unchanged.
We retain our estimates for FY27E and FY28E and keep the Target Price unchanged at Rs 876.
